description: Tool to list ChannelGroups on a property. Use when you need to retrieve channel groups that categorize traffic sources in Analytics reports.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing ChannelGroups on a property.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of resources to return. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. The maximum value is 200
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous ListChannelGroups call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. The property for which to list ChannelGroups. Format: properties/{property_id}
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: AnalyticsadminPropertiesChannelgroupsListRequest

name: list_channel_groups

channelGroups.description: An array of ChannelGroup objects representing the listed channel groups
channelGroups.title: Channel Groups

nextPageToken.description: A token for retrieving the next page of results. Empty if there are no more results
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

description.description: A text explanation of the channel group's purpose
description.title: Description

displayName.description: The human-readable name displayed in the Analytics interface
displayName.title: Display Name

groupingRule.description: The logic defining which traffic sources belong to this group
groupingRule.title: Grouping Rule

name.description: The resource name identifier for the channel group
name.title: Name

systemDefined.description: Indicates whether this is a default Analytics channel group (true) or a custom one (false)
systemDefined.title: System Defined

GroupingRule.description: Schema for a grouping rule within a channel group.

displayName.description: The display name of this grouping rule
displayName.title: Display Name

GroupingRule.title: GroupingRule
